proof_body:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, mul_zero, Nat.factorial, pow_zero, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, div_one, one_mul]
    exact Real.Gamma_one_half_eq
  | succ n ih =>
    have h : (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have e : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2 = (n : ℝ) + 1 / 2 + 1 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e, Real.Gamma_add_one h, ih]
    have f1 : ((2 * (n + 1)).factorial : ℝ) = (2 * n + 2) * (2 * n + 1) * ((2 * n).factorial : ℝ) := by
      rw [show 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 1 + 1 by ring, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_succ]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [f1, Nat.factorial_succ]
    push_cast
    have hn : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, Real.Gamma ((n : ℝ) + 1 / 2) = ((2 * n).factorial : ℝ) / (4 ^ n * (n.factorial : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt Real.pi
